findings.what: The acetanilide resonance pair at the foot of the page loses its curved mechanism arrows. The book draws two red curved arrows on the left-hand structure -- one from the nitrogen lone pair into the N-C bond and one from the C=O pi bond up onto the oxygen -- which is what shows how the right-hand charge-separated structure arises. The render prints both structures with no arrows at all, so the delocalisation the paragraph above describes is not shown.
findings.where: the two-structure resonance scheme at the bottom, under 'The lone pair of electrons on nitrogen of acetanilide interacts with oxygen'

findings.what: The same resonance pair loses the book's colour: the book sets the N, the C and the N=C bond in magenta and the curved arrows in red. The render prints the whole scheme in black. Colour is retained in the two bromination figures above, so the loss is specific to this typeset scheme.
